methodology.summary: Sequoia separates mentions, recommendations, primary recommendations, citations, referral visits, inquiries, qualified leads, and jobs booked. Findings are labeled Recorded, Observed, Inferred, or Unknown, and a result is never promoted to a later stage without the required evidence.
protocol: Freeze the question set and inclusion rules before observing answers.
Record platform, visible product, app or web surface, account state, search or browse state, device, geography, location method, and date.
Run each frozen question five times in separate fresh sessions per platform.
Treat repeats as stability observations, not statistically independent trials.
Archive the complete response and visible citations before coding the result.
Publish misses and limitations alongside favorable observations.
limitations: AI answers vary by platform, product version, prompt wording, geography, account state, memory, retrieval behavior, and date.
A citation is not automatically a recommendation.
A referral visit is not automatically an inquiry.
An inquiry is not automatically a qualified lead or job booked.
Repeated observations do not create a universal ranking.
Most AI products do not preserve an identity-level join from a generated answer to a later visitor.

caseStudyEvidence.name: A Fireman's Chimney Sweep
evidence: Search Console recorded 26 organic web-search clicks from June 5 to July 4, 2026, and 121 from September 14 to October 13, 2026, a rounded 365 percent increase.
Both windows follow the June 5 website launch. This is not old-site versus new-site traffic, and seasonal demand may contribute.
The source reports 8,174 and 25,915 impressions, while identifying a one-day spike that makes the impression increase a poor standalone measure.
These are dated organic website clicks, not unique customers, qualified leads or booked jobs. Google Business Profile growth is not claimed. Verified October 16, 2026.
